blocks.prompt: 23 Solve the initial value problem \(\frac{ds}{dt} + 2st = 0\); \(s = 4e\) when \(t = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan variables \(x, y\) ki jagah \(s\) aur \(t\) hain, lekin tareeqa bilkul wohi hai; naam badalne se maths nahi badalta.
\(\frac{ds}{dt} = -2st\) mein \(s\) wala hissa aur \(t\) wala hissa alag ho sakte hain, is liye equation separable hai.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur condition: \(t = 0\) par \(s = 4e\). Find kya karna hai? Particular solution \(s(t)\).
Rule kaunsa? Separable equation, phir initial condition se constant.
Plan: variables alag, integrate, exponential lena, condition lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{ds}{dt} + 2st = 0\), \(t = 0\) par \(s = 4e\).
Maloom karna: particular solution \(s(t)\).
Tareeqa: Separable equation, phir initial condition se constant nikalna.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{ds}{dt} = -2st\]
\[\dfrac{ds}{s} = -2t\,dt\]
Kyun: \(2st\) ko doosri taraf le gaye, phir \(s\) se divide kiya. \(s = 0\) nahi ho sakta kyunke shuru mein \(s = 4e\) hai.

Integrate karein
\[\ln|s| = -t^2 + c\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{s}\) ka integral \(\ln|s|\) aur \(-2t\) ka integral \(-t^2\) (power rule). Constant ko abhi sirf \(c\) likha hai kyunke agle qadam mein exponential lene par yeh khud hi multiply hone wala constant ban jayega.

Exponential lein
\[s = e^{-t^2 + c} = Ae^{-t^2}\]
Kyun: Log hatane ke liye dono taraf \(e\) ki power li. \(e^{-t^2 + c} = e^{c} \cdot e^{-t^2}\), aur \(\pm e^{c}\) ek constant hai jise \(A\) kaha.
Dhyan dein: \(s = e^{-t^2} + c\) likhna ghalat hai; constant exponential ke andar se bahar aa kar multiply hota hai, jama nahi hota.

\(t = 0\) par \(s = 4e\) lagayein
\[4e = Ae^{0} = A\]
\[s = 4e\cdot e^{-t^2} = 4e^{1 - t^2}\]
Kyun: \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(A = 4e\) seedha mil gaya. Phir exponent ka qanoon \(e^{a}\cdot e^{b} = e^{a + b}\) lagaya, yahan \(e = e^{1}\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{ds}{dt} = 4e^{1 - t^2}(-2t) = -2ts\]
is liye \(\frac{ds}{dt} + 2st = 0\) \(\checkmark\); aur \(s(0) = 4e^{1} = 4e\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Chain rule se \(1 - t^2\) ka derivative \(-2t\) bahar aaya; equation aur condition dono poori hui.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 26 par chhapa hai, 23 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 26 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(s = 4e^{1 - t^2}\), sahi hai.
